content:
As I mentioned on the community call the other day, Dataverse 6.12.1 is mostly a performance release. Highlights include:

  • Performance improvements
  • New and improved APIs
  • Bug fixes
  • Security fixes
  • Platform update: Payara upgraded to 7.2026.9

View release details and upgrade instructions here:
https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/releases/tag/v6.12.1

Enjoy!
